sentences.en: That's, as Nicole was saying, it's very hard to get a studio to let you have this kind of creative control.

sentences.en: Both of these films, One Battle After Another and Sinners, are both WB movies.

sentences.en: They're both Warner Brothers filMs.
sentences.zh: 它们都是华纳兄弟的片子。

sentences.en: And obviously the sale of Warner Brothers is the big entertainment story of the year.
sentences.zh: 显然，华纳兄弟的出售是今年娱乐界最大的新闻。

sentences.en: Nicole, you went on The Daily earlier this month when the news actually broke and talked about your reporting around that.
sentences.zh: 妮可，本月初消息刚爆出时，你上了《每日新闻》栏目，谈了你对此事的报道。

sentences.en: But I'd encourage our listeners to go check that out.
sentences.zh: 但我鼓励我们的听众去听听看。

sentences.en: The thing that I'm thinking about is that this comes at the end of an incredible wild year for Warner Brothers.
sentences.zh: 我想到的是，这发生在华纳兄弟经历疯狂、不可思议的一年的尾声。

sentences.en: We're all focusing on what's happening now.
sentences.zh: 我们都把焦点放在当下发生的事情上。

sentences.en: But if you look at the arc of how this company, and we're talking about this company on this podcast because of the movies they put out.
sentences.zh: 但如果你看看这家公司的发展轨迹——我们在这个播客里谈论这家公司是因为他们发行的电影。

sentences.en: If you look at their arc, it's been fascinating.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看他们的历程，会发现非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: Can you remind us where we were with Warner Brothers at the beginning of this year?
sentences.zh: 你能提醒我们，今年年初华纳兄弟处境如何吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: And specifically about the movie studio itself.
sentences.zh: 特别是电影制片厂本身。

sentences.en: Because it's run by Mike DeLuca and Pam Abdi.
sentences.zh: 因为它是迈克·德卢卡和帕姆·阿布迪在运营。

sentences.en: They're the co-chairmen of the studio.
sentences.zh: 他们是制片厂的联席主席。

sentences.en: And they, at the beginning of the year,
sentences.zh: 而他们在今年年初时，

sentences.zh: 面临着这样一种情绪：我认为这种情绪是由制片厂内部人士挑起的，他们暗示这两人随时都会被炒鱿鱼。

sentences.en: They had a rough 2024, a rough end of 2024, where they had Furiosa, then they had Todd Phillips' Joker sequel, which I really put that whole movie out of my mind so quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们度过了艰难的2024年，2024年底也很不好过，先是推出了《疯狂的麦克斯：狂暴女神》，接着又是托德·菲利普斯的《小丑》续集——我真的很快就把那整部电影抛到脑后了。

sentences.en: Anyway, sidebar.
sentences.zh: 总之，闲话少说。

sentences.zh: 因此有传言说他们随时可能被解雇。

sentences.en: And it was really like the drumbeat for it was really loud.

sentences.en: It just felt really kind of mean.

sentences.en: It prompted all these memes.

sentences.zh: 孩子们纷纷涌入电影院。

sentences.en: So that happened.
sentences.zh: 所以事情就是这样。

sentences.zh: 接着他们推出了《罪人》，按常理来说，它本不该成为票房热片。

sentences.en: You know, it's an expensive kind of arthouse-y kind of movie because it had a lot to say and had all these things.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它是一部成本较高、带点艺术片风格的电影，因为它有很多要表达的东西，包含了各种元素。

sentences.en: And then that, again, a huge hit.
sentences.zh: 结果它又成了一部大热片。

sentences.en: They have had this string of massive hits all through the year.
sentences.zh: 他们一整年都连续推出了多部大热卖的电影。

sentences.en: They had Weapons and they had Final Destination and we could talk about all these movies.
sentences.zh: 他们有《武器》和《死神来了》，我们可以聊聊所有这些电影。

sentences.en: And suddenly this movie studio has had just a run that we haven't seen in this business in a while from one studio.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这家电影公司创造了一段我们在这个行业里好久没从一家制片厂身上见过的辉煌战绩。

sentences.en: And then, of course, Superman 2, which – not Superman 2, but Superman also.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然还有《超人2》，它——不是《超人2》，也是《超人》。

sentences.en: They had this incredible run and it's still going and Oscars is likely going to go in their favor.
sentences.zh: 他们取得了不可思议的成绩，而且热潮还在继续，奥斯卡奖也很可能会向他们倾斜。

sentences.en: They did really well at the Golden Globe nominations.
sentences.zh: 他们在金球奖提名中表现得非常好。

sentences.en: And so we, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，

sentences.en: have this crazy success story for a company that is now going to be either part of Netflix or part of Paramount in the next 12 to 18 months whenever and if this deal gets done.
sentences.zh: 对于一家将在未来12到18个月内——无论交易何时以及是否达成——成为网飞（Netflix）一部分或派拉蒙一部分的公司来说，这是一个疯狂的成功故事。

sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该深入探讨一下其中的几部。

sentences.zh: 它在七月中旬上映。

sentences.zh: 这部电影由詹姆斯·古恩执导和编剧，除了是这部电影的创意核心之外，

sentences.zh: 他现在还是华纳兄弟整个DC漫画项目和宇宙的创意核心。

sentences.en: I mean, one thing that –
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一点——

sentences.en: Okay, so I loved this movie to the extent that I believe I put a critic's pick on it when I reviewed it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我很喜欢这部电影，以至于我在写影评时给它打上了“评论家首选”的标签。

sentences.en: I just enjoyed watching it.
sentences.zh: 我就是很享受观看的过程。

sentences.en: It has a very funny sense of humor, and it has a visual sense, too.
sentences.zh: 它有一种非常有趣的幽默感，视觉表现力也很强。

sentences.en: I mean, several of the best jokes in it are actually visual gags.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，里面几个最好的笑话其实都是视觉包袱。

sentences.en: And I knew where I was all the time when there were fight scenes, which I can't say for virtually any Marvel movie.
sentences.zh: 而且在有打斗场面时，我随时都知道自己在看哪里，几乎没有哪部漫威电影能做到这一点。

sentences.en: But also, one thing I loved about this movie and what it indicated to me is something James Gunn has said in his taking over of this,
sentences.zh: 另外，我喜欢这部电影的一点、以及它向我释放的信号，正是詹姆斯·古恩在接手这个项目时所说过的，

sentences.en: which is that we will make the movies when I feel like the screenplay is ready.
sentences.zh: 那就是：只有当我觉得剧本准备就绪时，我们才会拍电影。

sentences.en: And I have not always felt that out of Marvel.
sentences.zh: 我在漫威身上并不总能感受到这一点。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's felt like they're making the movie because, well, they have to get the next puzzle piece in place because they've got a production schedule to stay on.
sentences.zh: 有时感觉他们拍电影是因为，嗯，他们必须把下一块拼图放到位，因为他们有必须遵守的制作日程。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They have those events where they announce all the dates.
sentences.zh: 他们经常搞那种活动来宣布所有上映日期。

sentences.en: And it's like, this is when this movie is coming out.
sentences.zh: 就好像：这部电影将在这个时候上映。

sentences.en: This is when this movie is coming out.
sentences.zh: 那部电影将在这个时候上映。

sentences.en: And, you know, we don't know what movie is coming out in this state, but there will be a movie.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们不知道某个日期具体会上映什么电影，但反正会有一部电影。

sentences.en: There will be a movie on this state.
sentences.zh: 那个日期一定会有一部电影上映。

sentences.en: And so, you know, for me, that signals someone who's thinking about these as filMs.
sentences.zh: 所以，对我来说，这标志着一个把这些作品当成真正的电影来思考的人。

sentences.en: And, you know, ironically, the times I've felt that in the Marvel universe, it's been like the movie directed by Ryan Coogler.
sentences.zh: 而且，具有讽刺意味的是，我在漫威宇宙中感受到这种匠心的时候，往往就像瑞恩·库格勒执导的电影那样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this one just feels like a movie that has thoughts in its head and it's, you know, saying something.
sentences.zh: 所以这部电影感觉就是一部有深度、有思想、在表达某种东西的作品。

sentences.en: It actually says something real.
sentences.zh: 它确实表达了一些真实的东西。

sentences.en: And, you know, as soon as I saw it and I'm sure, you know, you felt the same way.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我一看到它——我确信你也有同感。

sentences.en: I thought, oh, this is going to kick up controversy.
sentences.zh: 我就想，哦，这下要引发争议了。

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.zh: 确实引发了。

sentences.en: And it still went on to make a ton of money.
sentences.zh: 但它依然斩获了巨额票房。

sentences.zh: 你怎么没提那只狗？

sentences.zh: 哦，还有那只狗，当然。

sentences.zh: 妮可，如果这一切真的通过了，DC会怎么样？

sentences.en: Oh, boy.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: It's going to be a nice little tile on Netflix's home screen.
sentences.zh: 它会变成网飞主屏幕上的一个小精美图标吧。

sentences.zh: 不，我们还不知道。

sentences.zh: 这算是他们的重启。

sentences.zh: 正如你所说，他们在詹姆斯·古恩和彼得·萨夫兰的新领导下。

sentences.en: And so far, so good.
sentences.zh: 目前为止一切顺利。

sentences.en: They're showing that they are making movies that people want to see.
sentences.zh: 他们正在证明自己拍出了人们想看的电影。

sentences.en: And Supergirl is the next one on the liSt.

sentences.zh: 这也是华纳兄弟成为一块诱人收购目标的部分原因，因为他们确实拥有庞大的资产库，整个DC宇宙就是其中之一。

sentences.en: And so that's why Paramount wants them.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么派拉蒙想要他们。

sentences.en: And that's why Netflix wants them.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么网飞想要他们。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，网飞已经表示他们将维持华纳兄弟的院线业务，并且会继续将电影搬上大银幕。

sentences.en: We have no idea how long that will last, and we have no idea how committed they are, even though they are saying so,

sentences.zh: 因为他们从来都不是大银幕观影体验的狂热拥趸。

sentences.en: They want movies to come to their platform as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们希望电影能尽快登陆自家平台。

sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他们为了谈成这笔交易，好话说尽。

sentences.en: So if they get it, we'll cross that bridge when we get there.

sentences.zh: 事实上我喝了几杯小啤酒，而且我的座位夹在一群我不认识的人中间，因为我是独自一人去的。

sentences.en: So I was between all these ladies and they were screaming, which was really the best way to see it.
sentences.zh: 所以我坐在这些女士中间，她们一直在尖叫，这真的是观看这部电影的最佳方式。

sentences.en: But then I was at my local wine bar and they were like, we're going to throw weapons on, which they did.
sentences.zh: 但后来我去当地的葡萄酒吧，他们说，我们要放映《武器》，然后他们真的放了。

sentences.en: And so everyone in the room seemed to have not seen it except me.
sentences.zh: 所以房间里的每个人似乎都没看过，除了我。

sentences.en: And I can tell you that is also a great way to see it.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，这也是观看这部电影的绝佳方式。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: It was delightful.
sentences.zh: 太美妙了。

sentences.en: Alyssa, you have the best movie going experiences and they all involve small beers or small wines or small wines.
sentences.zh: 艾莉莎，你的观影体验总是最棒的，而且它们都伴随着小杯啤酒、小杯葡萄酒，或者小杯葡萄酒。

sentences.en: I unfortunately saw it on the airplane because I'm super chicken when it comes to scary movies.
sentences.zh: 我倒霉是在飞机上看的，因为我对恐怖片超级怂。

sentences.en: So I was like, I got to watch it.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，我得把它看完。

sentences.en: But in this case, I'll be fine.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，我应该会没事。

sentences.en: And then I was wanting to scream, too.
sentences.zh: 然后我也开始想尖叫。

sentences.en: But I kept it all tamped down.
sentences.zh: 但我把这种冲动全克制住了。

sentences.en: I mean, the one of many interesting things about this film is that it's a horror movie, in quotes,
sentences.zh: 我是说，这部电影众多有趣之处之一在于，它是一部“引号里的”恐怖片，

sentences.en: but it's actually it's mostly just a suspense mystery that has a couple of horrific elements.
sentences.zh: 但实际上它大部分时间只是一部包含了一些恐怖元素的悬疑神秘片。

sentences.en: There are a couple of jump scares.
sentences.zh: 里面有几次突然惊吓的镜头。

sentences.en: There are actually not that many.
sentences.zh: 其实数量并没有那么多。

sentences.en: And then, you know, there's sort of a grand guignol ending in a sense.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，从某种意义上说，它有一个类似大吉尼奥尔（Grand Guignol）风格的血腥高潮结尾。

sentences.en: But a lot of this is just sort of like, what is happening?
sentences.zh: 但很大程度上只是一种“这到底是怎么回事？”的感觉。

sentences.en: What is going on?
sentences.zh: 到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Where did these kids disappear to?
sentences.zh: 这些孩子都消失到哪去了？

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 对的，对的。

sentences.en: And Zack Kreger's background is in comedy, too, which I think really comes out in this film.
sentences.zh: 而且扎克·克雷格的背景也是喜剧出身，我觉得这在这部电影中得到了充分体现。

sentences.en: Just the timing is impeccable.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是节奏就无可挑剔。

sentences.en: There's a scene, again, I don't want to spoil it, but there's a scene involving a door and some scissors where everybody, the timing is just, it's perfect.
sentences.zh: 有一个场景，再说一次，我不想剧透，但有一个涉及一扇门和几把剪刀的场景，每个人的节奏都恰到好处，堪称完美。

sentences.en: Like the way everything happens, you're spun up.
sentences.zh: 就像所有事情发生的方式一样，把你的神经都调动起来了。

sentences.en: I mean, I've seen it a couple of times and both times I was like, ah, you know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我看过好几次，每一次我都觉得，啊，你懂的。

sentences.en: I thought you were going to say the scene with the syringes.
sentences.zh: 我还以为你要说带有注射器的那个场景呢。

sentences.en: Well, there's not two.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不止两处。

sentences.en: Okay, maybe it is a horror movie.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许它确实是一部恐怖片。

sentences.en: I mean, it is.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它本来就是。

sentences.en: You know, Barbarian also is one of the most terrifying movies I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 你知道，《野蛮人》也是我看过的最让人毛骨悚然的电影之一。

sentences.en: So, but, you know, comedy and horror are just two sides of the same point.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，喜剧和恐怖只是硬币的两面。

sentences.en: Well, Barbarian, if I'm recalling correctly, the end of that movie is terrifying and hilarious at the same time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，《野蛮人》，如果我没记错的话，那部电影的结尾既让人感到恐惧又让人爆笑。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 对的，对的。

sentences.en: It is a terrifying and hilarious movie.
sentences.zh: 这是一部既可怕又搞笑的电影。

sentences.en: So, yeah, if you know how to make people laugh, you know how to make them scream, so.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你知道怎么把人逗笑，你就知道怎么把人吓哭，所以。

sentences.en: All right, let's take a little break.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们休息一下。

sentences.en: And when we come back, we're going to talk about witches, good ones and wicked ones.
sentences.zh: 等我们回来，我们要聊聊女巫，好女巫和坏女巫。

sentences.en: We're going to talk about Avatar, Fire and Ash, one of the big movies of the year that has just come out.
sentences.zh: 我们要聊聊刚刚上映的今年大片之一《阿凡达：火与灰》。

sentences.en: And we might even talk about some great movies that you haven't heard about yet or haven't had a chance to see.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至可能会聊一些你还没听说过或者还没来得及看的精彩电影。

sentences.en: We'll be back in a second.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的字谜游戏 Connections。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责创作 Spelling Bee 和 Letterboxd 游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色彩联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚刚你听到的那些人一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 从今天开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Nicole, we've been talking a lot about Warner Brothers.
sentences.zh: 所以，妮可，我们一直在讨论华纳兄弟。

sentences.en: We were talking about movie-wise how great their year was.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才在谈论就电影而言他们的这一年有多么伟大。

sentences.en: But it actually has been, at the same time, a bit of a crummy year and certainly a crummy fall for many other studios, many other movies.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，对许多其他制片厂和许多其他电影来说，这一年其实也有点糟糕，对许多秋季档电影而言更是如此。

sentences.en: You know, our colleague Brooks Barnes wrote a story in mid-fall about how October was just the bust of all busts.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们的同事布鲁克斯·巴恩斯在仲秋时写过一篇报道，讲述了十月是如何成为票房惨淡中的“灾难之最”的。

sentences.en: You know, it was the worst October at the box office in almost 30 years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是近30年来票房表现最惨淡的十月。

sentences.en: You had movies like The Smashing Machine, a third, for some reason, Tron movie, The Springsteen movie, The Running Man, Roof Man.
sentences.zh: 你看到了诸如《传奇摔跤手》、不知为何拍到第三部的《创：战神》、斯普林斯廷传记片、《越命奔逃》、《屋顶人》这样的电影。

sentences.en: You know, movies that sort of had movie stars and all just sort of went floppity-flop.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些似乎拥有电影明星阵容的电影，结果全都一败涂地。

sentences.en: What happened there?
sentences.zh: 那里发生了什么？

sentences.en: I mean, Hollywood could not catch a break.
sentences.zh: 我是说，好莱坞简直时运不济。

sentences.en: It was like everything they threw at the screen just didn't stick.
sentences.zh: 就像他们搬上银幕的一切都石沉大海了一样。

sentences.en: Whether it was a big sci-fi movie like Tron, whether it was a biopic about a beloved musician like The Springsteen movie,
sentences.zh: 无论是像《创》这样的大型科幻电影，还是关于像斯普林斯廷这样的受人爱戴的音乐家的传记片，

sentences.en: whether it was movies starring Margot Robbie, Colin Farrell, Channing Tatum, Jennifer Lopez, Austin Butler, Robert Pattinson, Emma Stone, Russell Crowe.
sentences.zh: 无论是主演阵容包括玛格特·罗比、科林·法瑞尔、查宁·塔图姆、詹妮弗·洛佩兹、奥斯汀·巴特勒、罗伯特·帕丁森、艾玛·斯通、罗素·克劳的电影。

sentences.en: Like, name all these famous movie stars that people usually run out to the theaters to see and nothing hit.
sentences.zh: 就像历数所有这些人们通常会蜂拥至影院观看的著名电影明星，结果没有一部卖座。

sentences.en: And it was really grim.
sentences.zh: 这真的非常惨淡。

sentences.en: And it's—I don't know if there's one explanation for it.
sentences.zh: 而且——我不知道这是否能用单一的解释来概括。

sentences.en: I think there's many explanations.
sentences.zh: 我认为有多种解释。

sentences.en: I think we're living in an era where getting people's attention has become harder and harder.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们生活在一个吸引人们注意变得越来越难的时代。

sentences.en: I think if critic reviews come out, social media spreads super faSt.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果影评一出来，社交媒体就会超级光速地传播开来。

sentences.en: Like, you know if you have a hit or a bomb before something even debuts, marketing can no longer hide that any longer.
sentences.zh: 就像，你甚至在影片首映之前就知道它会大卖还是惨败，营销手段再也无法掩盖这一点了。

sentences.en: It's just—the movie business has always been a really tough business.
sentences.zh: 这简直是——电影行业一直都是一个极其艰难的行业。

sentences.en: This fall felt like it was almost impossible.
sentences.zh: 这个秋季档感觉简直是不可能完成的任务。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was a bummer fall.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人沮丧的秋季档。

sentences.en: But all of a sudden, around Thanksgiving time, something happened.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，在感恩节前后，事情发生了变化。

sentences.en: Wicked for Good, the sequel to the first musical about, you know, Glinda the Good and Elphaba, the Wicked Witch, came out and made a ton of money.
sentences.zh: 关于善女格林达和恶女埃尔法巴的第一部音乐剧的续集《魔法坏女巫：第二部分》上映了，并且赚了巨额票房。

sentences.en: It's not going to make as much money as the first one, but it was this, you know, pink and green injection into the box office.
sentences.zh: 它可能不会像第一部那样赚那么多钱，但这可以说是给票房注射了一剂粉绿相间的强心针。

sentences.en: I feel like it desperately needed.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是它极度需要的。

sentences.en: We had a whole episode here on the Sunday special about Wicked for Good.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至在周日特别节目里专门做了一整期关于《魔法坏女巫：第二部分》的节目。

sentences.en: Neither of you were on it, so I'd love to hear any thoughts if you have them.
sentences.zh: 你们两个当时都没参加，所以如果你有什么想法，我很乐意听听。

sentences.en: I mean, I did not—I was not so into it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我其实没有——我没那么喜欢它。

sentences.en: I enjoyed the first one more, but I, you know, am happy about people going to a theater and enjoying a movie.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢第一部，不过，你知道的，我为人们去电影院看电影并乐在其中感到高兴。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So that's kind of my feeling.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我的感受。

sentences.en: Also, I had multiple people comment to me that it felt like the marketing push wasn't as big for this one.
sentences.zh: 另外，有很多人向我评论说，感觉这部电影的宣传推广力度没有上一部那么大。

sentences.en: And as I pointed out to them, the marketing for this one is the previous movie that everyone saw.
sentences.zh: 正如我向他们指出的那样，这部电影的宣传就是所有人都看过的上一部电影。

sentences.en: So I think that accounts for, you know, box office.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这解释了票房表现。

sentences.en: And it is the kind of movie that I think will have legs.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这是一部会很长寿的电影。

sentences.en: Like, people will still be seeing it into the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 就像，人们在整个假期里都还会去看它。

sentences.en: So I continue to find Ariana Grande in particular delightful in this movie as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我依然觉得爱莉安娜·格兰德在这部电影里的表现格外讨人喜欢。

sentences.en: And it's made $300 million in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且它在美国已经斩获了3亿美元的票房。

sentences.en: so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止。

sentences.en: So it's not exactly—so it's doing great.
sentences.zh: 所以它绝不是——它表现得很棒。

sentences.en: Yeah, not a flop.
sentences.zh: 是的，不是票房毒药。

sentences.en: Not a flop at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不是票房毒药。

sentences.en: And also, how do you go bigger than the first Wicked movie when it comes to marketing?
sentences.zh: 而且话说回来，在营销方面，你怎么可能做到比第一部《魔法坏女巫》还要盛大呢？

sentences.en: I mean, that was an insane marketing push.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那是一场疯狂的营销攻势。

sentences.en: Like, that was really tremendous.
sentences.zh: 真的可以说是极其浩大。

sentences.en: Alyssa, what did you think about the politics of the film?
sentences.zh: 艾莉莎，你对这部电影的政治隐喻怎么看？

sentences.en: I mean, it has them.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它确实有这些内容。

sentences.en: It gets much floppier in the second one, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在第二部里，这方面变得更加软弱无力了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's funny because these are movies kind of very explicitly about fascism.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这很有趣，因为这些电影非常直白地就是关于法西斯主义的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I don't know if it's as obvious in the second one.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它在第二部里是否还那么显眼。

sentences.en: Did you feel for the animals in the same way that Elphaba did?
sentences.zh: 你对动物们的同理心和埃尔法巴是一样的吗？

sentences.en: I feel like this is a trap.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一个陷阱。

sentences.en: It's not a trap.
sentences.zh: 这不是陷阱。

sentences.en: It's a setup for a transition, which is to talk about our next film, which is about animals.
sentences.zh: 这是为接下来要谈论的下一部关于动物的电影做铺垫。

sentences.en: I felt deeply for the animals, but not the way that I feel about crypto.
sentences.zh: 我对动物们充满了深深的同情，但不是我对加密货币那种感觉。

sentences.en: Crypto with a K.
sentences.zh: 用 K 开头的 Crypto（加密货币）。

sentences.en: Let's talk about Zootopia 2.
sentences.zh: 我们来聊聊《疯狂动物城2》。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, Karen has chosen to see Joel's smile as a sign of aggression.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，凯伦把乔尔的微笑当作了挑衅的信号。

sentences.en: Hackles down, Karen.
sentences.zh: 收起你的怒毛吧，凯伦。

sentences.en: This one came out right before Thanksgiving, and holy cow, so many people went to see it.
sentences.zh: 这部电影在感恩节前夕上映，天呐，有那么多的人去观看。

sentences.en: I did not know that there were this many people who had been waiting so long, you know, for the further adventures of Judy Hopps and Nick the Fox.
sentences.zh: 我不知道有这么多人等了这么久，你知道的，为了朱迪·霍普斯和尼克狐狸的后续冒险故事。

sentences.en: I mean, it's quite a beloved movie in my household, and my teenagers are almost no longer teenagers.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在我家里这是一部非常受欢迎的电影，而我的孩子们都已经快不再是青少年了。

sentences.en: So there's something sticky about this movie that really brought people back to the theaters.
sentences.zh: 所以这部电影有一种独特的黏性，真正把人们带回了电影院。

sentences.en: Did you guys see any of the screenings that were happening in China where they were letting people come to the theaters with their pets and watch it with them?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有看到中国正在进行的一些放映活动，他们允许人们带着宠物去电影院一起观看？

sentences.en: It's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: I don't know how I feel about that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我对此作何感想。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Like, what kind of animals?
sentences.zh: 就像，都是些什么动物？

sentences.en: I mean, it was, I think mostly dogs.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我想大部分是狗。

sentences.en: Horses.
sentences.zh: 马。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I have a very large dog that almost is like a mini horse, so if he had come to the theater, it would have been quite a scene.
sentences.zh: 我有一只非常大的狗，几乎就像一匹小马，所以如果他去了电影院，那场面一定会相当壮观。

sentences.en: Can a cat, like, stay still for a movie?
sentences.zh: 猫能安安静静地看完一场电影吗？

sentences.en: Do they have the attention span?
sentences.zh: 它们的注意力能集中那么久吗？

sentences.en: I think cats can do whatever they want.
sentences.zh: 我觉得猫想干什么就干什么。

sentences.en: I mean, this does raise something, which is that it feels like there's, I hear this from parents all the time, that there aren't enough movies for children ever in theaters.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这确实引发了一个问题，那就是我经常从父母那里听到这种说法，影院里从来没有足够的儿童电影。

sentences.en: And it seems like many parents are desperate to have something to do with their kids, especially when the weather is bad.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎许多父母都迫切需要能和孩子们一起做的事，尤其是在天气不好的时候。

sentences.en: And a movie is a nice thing to go do.
sentences.zh: 看电影是一件很棒的消遣活动。

sentences.en: And every time there's like a halfway passably decent movie for kids in the theaters, it makes a ton of money and everyone seems really surprised by this.
sentences.zh: 而且每当影院里有一部马马虎虎算得上还行的儿童电影时，它就能赚到大把钞票，每个人对此似乎都感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: But I feel like when I was a kid, there was a movie, a new kids movie in the theater like every weekend.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得我小时候，电影院里几乎每个周末都有一部新的儿童电影。

sentences.en: And where are they?
sentences.zh: 他们去哪了？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.zh: 还记得第一部上映的时候大家是怎么没完没了地去看吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it was insanity.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Nicole, how do you think the movie business is going to end up feeling about this year as a whole?
sentences.zh: 妮可，你觉得整个电影行业今年下来感觉会怎么样？

sentences.en: Oh, that's such a loaded question.
sentences.zh: 哦，这可真是一个充满诱导性的问题。

sentences.en: I think the biggest concern right now for the industry is what is going to happen with Warner Brothers.
sentences.zh: 我认为目前行业最担忧的是华纳兄弟会怎么样。

sentences.en: Consolidation is not good for any industry, and that's true of Hollywood as well.
sentences.zh: 行业整合对任何行业都不是好事，好莱坞也是如此。

sentences.en: Ironically, what we have seen this year has been kind of astounding.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，我们今年看到的情况可以说是相当惊人。

sentences.en: We've seen a lot of lows that we talked about, but we also saw a lot of highs with films that were completely original, that are not based on IP, that are not the things,
sentences.zh: 我们经历了讨论过的很多低谷，但也看到了很多完全原创的电影带来的高峰，它们不基于IP，也不是那些，

sentences.en: the tried and true Hollywood formula that have done really well.
sentences.zh: 经受过时间考验且行之有效的好莱坞公式，却取得了极佳的成绩。

sentences.en: So if, like, we didn't have all these outside economics of which company is carrying which debt and which shareholders are upset about the performance of a certain company,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们不用去管那些乱七八糟的外部经济因素——比如哪家公司背负着什么债务，哪些股东对某家公司的业绩感到不满——

sentences.en: we would have had a year that really shows that, like, taking risks and being imaginative and original really pays off.
sentences.zh: 我们本来可以迎来一个真正证明“勇于冒险、富有想象力和原创精神确实能得到回报”的年份。

sentences.en: I mean, if we were just dealing with strictly art, we'd be in such a better place.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我们纯粹只谈艺术，我们的处境就会好得多。

sentences.en: But instead, the commerce has really taken over in such a profound way that we're going to see a business that has already contracted keep contracting.

sentences.en: And it's not going to be great for artists.
sentences.zh: 这对艺术家来说可不是什么好事。

sentences.en: It's not going to be great for all those people that have, you know, dedicated their lives to making movies.
sentences.zh: 对所有那些，你知道的，把一生奉献给电影事业的人来说也不是好事。

sentences.en: And so right now, things are not so super in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 所以目前，好莱坞的情况并不是那么妙。

sentences.zh: 你知道吗，妮可？

sentences.en: I think you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你说的完全正确。

sentences.en: However, we are not going to end this episode on a down note.

sentences.en: And I want to start with Alyssa, who wants to talk about a little ping pong player.

sentences.en: A little ping pong player played by Timothee Chalamet in a movie called Marty Supreme.

sentences.en: Hello?

sentences.zh: 嘿，我是马蒂·莫瑟。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: You know, I'm something of a performer, too.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，其实我也算是个表演者。

sentences.en: It is about a young man in the 1950s who is on a quest to become a champion ping pong player.
sentences.zh: 它讲述了一个20世纪50年代的年轻人渴望成为乒乓球冠军的故事。

sentences.en: I had so much fun with this movie.
sentences.zh: 看这部电影我真的获得了极大的乐趣。

sentences.en: And honestly, the early reviews or the early responses had been so positive that I kind of went in with my arms crossed.
sentences.zh: 老实说，早期的评论和反馈是如此积极，以至于我一开始是抱着双臂、带着戒备去看的。

sentences.en: But it totally won me over.
sentences.zh: 但它彻底把我征服了。

sentences.en: It has the best performance I've seen out of Gwyneth Paltrow in years.

sentences.en: An amazing, like, Fran Drescher performance, which is not something I was expecting to say this year.

sentences.zh: 总之，如果你喜欢《原钻》，你就会喜欢《至尊马蒂》。

sentences.en: But even if you didn't, you should give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 但即使你不喜欢，你也应该给它一次机会。

sentences.zh: 感觉这就应该是你在这个季节看的电影。

sentences.en: Nicole, you want to talk about a film that has won a ton of awards this year so far.
sentences.zh: 妮可，你想聊一部今年到目前为止赢得无数奖项的电影。

sentences.en: It won the top prize at Cannes this summer.
sentences.zh: 它今年夏天赢得了戛纳最高奖项。

sentences.en: It is by one of World Cinema's, you know, most acclaimed directors.
sentences.zh: 它出自世界影坛，你知道的，最受赞誉的导演之一。

sentences.en: Yes, this is, it was just an accident by Jafar Panahi, who's an Iranian filmmaker.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是伊朗电影人贾法·帕纳西的《只是个意外》。

sentences.en: And he did win the Palme d'Or in Cannes.
sentences.zh: 他确实赢得了戛纳金棕榈奖。

sentences.en: It was acquired by Neon, and they have released the last five or six Palme d'Ors, giving Tom Quinn the nickname of Palme d'Oracle.

sentences.en: And it's a tremendous film that Panahi shot in Iran, kind of undercover.

sentences.en: And that is not something that Mr. Panahi, who has spent time in jail for making movies, was willing to do.

sentences.en: So, it was a run-and-gun operation.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一次游击式的拍摄行动。

sentences.en: It's about a group of people who have previously been in prison, and they think they found the man who tortured them.
sentences.zh: 它讲述了一群曾经入狱的人，他们觉得自己找到了折磨过他们的人。

sentences.en: And they're trying to determine if it is, in fact, that person.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图确定这是否真的是那个人。

sentences.en: It's actually funny.
sentences.zh: 它其实挺有趣的。

sentences.en: It's really well done.
sentences.zh: 拍得真的很好。

sentences.en: And it has so much to say about who are the evil ones, and what kind of, and how you behave in these kind of situations, and how do you forgive,
sentences.zh: 它对谁是恶魔、在那种情况下你会有什么样表现、以及如何去宽恕，有着诸多的探讨，

sentences.en: and all these kind of very interesting questions.
sentences.zh: 还有所有这些非常有趣的问题。

sentences.en: And it's tremendous.
sentences.zh: 而且它非常震撼。

sentences.en: And Panahi, I believe, will likely get a director nomination from the Academy this year.
sentences.zh: 我相信帕纳西今年很可能会获得学院奖的导演提名。

sentences.en: It's that good.
sentences.zh: 它就是这么优秀。

sentences.en: Well, I agree with all of that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我完全同意这些看法。

sentences.en: I also just really respect Panahi and his gumption.
sentences.zh: 我也非常尊敬帕纳西和他的魄力。

sentences.en: Every movie he's made has been phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 他拍的每一部电影都堪称非凡。

sentences.en: And, you know, I've been seeing them at Cannes for years, but he's not been able to be there because there's always been a travel ban, or he's been under house arrest,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我多年来一直在戛纳看他的作品，但他一直无法亲临现场，因为总是有旅行禁令，或者他被软禁，

sentences.en: or in prison.
sentences.zh: 或者在狱中。

sentences.en: And this was the first time that he has been traveling.
sentences.zh: 而这是他第一次能够四处旅行。

sentences.en: And he was here in New York for the New York Film Festival.
sentences.zh: 他当时在纽约参加纽约电影节。

sentences.en: You know, I was able to see him in conversation with Martin Scorsese, and it was clear how much, you know, Scorsese really.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我有幸看到他和马丁·斯科塞斯对话，很明显斯科塞斯是多么地……

sentences.en: He respected him.
sentences.zh: 他非常尊敬他。

sentences.en: So, it's just, it's a great film.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的是一部伟大的电影。

sentences.en: I hope people really make a point of seeing it.
sentences.zh: 我希望人们一定要去看看。

sentences.en: I hope so, too.
sentences.zh: 我也希望如此。

sentences.en: And I, you know, I recently saw this one, and it's a tight sort of social thriller, almoSt.
sentences.zh: 而且我，你知道的，我最近看这部片子时，觉得它几乎是一部紧凑的社会惊悚片。

sentences.en: And I'd say the last two scenes of this, you know, it's hard to do a great ending.

sentences.en: And it's just a knockout.
sentences.zh: 而它简直是一个王炸。

sentences.en: I mean, it's emotional.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它极具情感冲击力。

sentences.en: It's incredibly tense.

sentences.en: It's sort of scary in its own way.
sentences.zh: 以它自己的方式来说，甚至有点吓人。

sentences.en: It's incredible.
sentences.zh: 太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And the increasing internationalization of the Academy over the past few years, resulting in Parasite winning Best Picture and, you know,

sentences.en: movies directed by non-American directors getting Best Director nominations, I think is just going to continue, you know,
sentences.zh: 非美国导演执导的电影获得了最佳导演提名，我认为这种趋势还会继续，

sentences.en: with this or with a film like Sentimental Value or other films like that this year.

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.en: Also an excellent movie.

sentences.en: I know.
